nom: BIODANCE Collagen Peptides Jelly Serum Mist

segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin report noticeable, lasting hydration and say it works well as a stand-alone moisturizer, including in a dry climate; one detailed review cautions that HA-based mists like this one can further dehydrate very dry or dehydrated skin if not layered with a heavier moisturizer.
segments.combination: The reviewers with combination skin use it as their main moisturizer and say it hydrates well, though one living in a dry climate still finds some areas of her face dehydrated and measures moisture around 40 with a skin meter.
segments.sensitive: Most reviewers who describe sensitive skin say it causes no irritation and appreciate that it is fragrance-free, including one with rosacea and fragrance sensitivities; one dissenting and more serious review reports itching, a rash on the neck, and puffy, red eyes developing after about a week of twice-daily use, and concludes it is not meant for sensitive skin.
segments.normal: One reviewer describes her skin as normal but dehydrated and sometimes reactive to actives, and says the mist caused no irritation despite that, crediting the fragrance-free formula.
segments.mature: Reviewers in their 40s to 60s report a plumper, smoother, more lifted look and less noticeable fine lines with regular use, including one who says a scratch on her hand healed faster and her facial pores looked smaller, and another who calls it the best plumping mist she has used for mature skin.

concerns.aging: Reviewers using it against fine lines and for firmness, several in their 50s and 60s, report a plumper, smoother, more lifted look after regular use, and one says a scratch on her hand and her enlarged facial pores both improved faster than expected; one dissenting review says it does not plump the face or work as an anti-aging product.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers, including several with dry skin, say it delivers immediate and lasting hydration and softness, some using it as a stand-alone moisturizer; dissent includes one review saying the hydration fades and skin feels dry again within the hour, and another cautioning that HA-based mists like this can further dehydrate dry skin if not layered with a heavier moisturizer.
concerns.redness: One reviewer with mild rosacea, which is triggered by fragrance, says the fragrance-free formula lets her use it without setting off her usual flare.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer says the mist leaves a thin layer that functions as a barrier against moisture loss through the day; a separate and more serious review describes itching, a rash on the neck, and puffy, red eyes appearing after about a week of twice-daily use, concluding the formula is not suited to sensitive skin.
concerns.blemishes: A couple of reviewers note it did not cause new breakouts, including one who describes her skin as not very sensitive and another who reports no irritation or breakout problems after adding it to her routine.

extraits.texte: I usually don’t leave reviews but for this product I had to. I have been using the same skin care routine for years and haven’t changed any products on my face or hair in a long time, but when I came across this spray I was really curious and excited to try it out specially because it had collagen in it and comes from a reputable brand. After a couple days of using this product about 2 times a day I started feeling itchy on my face, thinking nothing of it I continued using it and by the first week broke out into a rash on my neck and my puffy and red eyes. I really loved the effect this product had after using it, it left my skin so shiny and hydrated but it is not meant for sensitive skin and I’m sure they have not perfected the ingredients in it just hey either. Definitely be cautious using it if you are a first time user. I recommend rubbing a little on a small part of your neck for a few days to see how you react to or not get this product at all.

It’s okay I guess not seeing any result that wow me. Does it moisturize? Yes in the moment. Does my face feel dry within the hour? Also yes I fell for the cute presentation and I do like the texture however I don’t see any results that would have me purchase again. The one I received also leaked a little so it wasn’t a full bottle.

extraits.titre: Beautiful hydrating mist for normal skin; HA-loaded, not so effective for dry skin
extraits.texte: BIODANCE Caviar PDRN Jelly Serum Mist is a Korean hydrating face mist. It comes in a cute plastic bottle with a spray-type dispenser, the bottle is nicely heavy, it’s pleasant to touch and to look at. Mist appears as a beautiful light-magenta jelly/hydrogel. The product features mainly caviar water and 5 types of hyaluronic acid (HA). It is good that caviar water is presented at the first place with 76% of the content and substitutes the water here. However, “caviar water” is a rather general term, the concentration and composition of active components in such steam distillates are not fixed or well regulated, so it might vary significantly between different manufacturers and actually be very low. The serum mist is applied via a spray-type dispenser, it does not appear as a mist cloud, more like small droplets that I need to tap for absorption. By definition, it immediately delivers some moisture to the skin, but the resulted performance largely depends on the skin type. If you have dry or dehydrated skin or live in dry air environment, then this product should not be used as a solo product. Similar to other HA-loaded mists/serums, the skin can feel even drier after the application than before, as HA might dehydrate the skin by pulling moisture from deeper layers of the skin rather than the air (with low moisture). I have combination skin and live in dry climate, some parts of the face feel sometimes dehydrated. When I use a skin hydration meter, it shows moisture level as 40

extraits.titre: Ultra-Fine Mist That Actually Hydrates & Plumps Mature Skin
extraits.texte: I’m 52, post-menopausal, with dry, sometimes sensitive skin, and I’m very particular about mists — most are either too wet, too fragranced, or just don’t do much. This one is different, and I’ve been really enjoying it. The first thing to know (and this makes a big difference): if you don’t hold it too close to your face, it creates a very fine, even mist. When sprayed from a bit of distance, it disperses beautifully and feels light and refreshing rather than leaving droplets sitting on the skin. The texture is slightly more substantial than a typical water mist — you can feel that there’s something in it. It gives immediate hydration and a soft, plumped look without feeling sticky or heavy. My skin looks fresher right after using it, which is exactly what I want from a mist. I use this in a few different ways: • As a first hydrating layer after cleansing • Between skincare steps for “skin flooding” • During the day to refresh and bring life back to my skin It layers extremely well and doesn’t disrupt anything underneath or on top. It actually helps everything feel more cohesive and comfortable. The collagen and peptides make this feel a bit more treatment-focused than your average mist. It’s not just refreshing — it feels like it’s actively supporting hydration and helping the skin look smoother and more supple over time. I also appreciate that it doesn’t leave any tackiness. That’s often my biggest issue with hydrating mists, especially for mature skin, but this one leaves

I have found Biodance to create high quality skincare products; although they don't always work for me, this is a good skincare company. When I saw this caviar PDRN jelly serum mist, I was excited to try it. Fortunately, this one works for me! I'm impressed by the ingredient list. I ran the ingredients through Beautypedia, and almost all of the ingredients rated very highly. The two or three that didn't rated average, with no ingredients in the "bad" or "worst" categories. I'm especially pleased that this mist is fragrance-free. I have mild rosacea, which is triggered by fragrance, and I also have some fragrance sensitivities (fragrance can give me headaches). It can be difficult to find skincare without fragrance, so I'm always happy to find things that are fragrance-free. The bottle is cute, portable, and easy to use; one pump of spray is all you really need for your face. I did find the mist to be a bit tacky, but it wasn't enough to turn off the product. I appreciate the hydration it delivers. I have used this both under and over makeup and didn't notice any difference in performance. Overall, I'm happy with this product.

extraits.titre: Helps my skin look more youthful than before
extraits.texte: I love this product. I even started to use it on my hands and definitely noticed a difference. I’m 68 and my hands always looked dry and wrinkly. I ended up with a scratch on my hand a few days ago and noticed it healed much faster than normal. Wasn’t expecting that at all. I decided to use it on my feet recently and am noticing a difference also. A little stickiness noticed on my hands and feet but nothing I can’t live with. Now as far as my face, I’ve always had large pores but this product has helped greatly with the size of them. They’re definitely still there but so much smaller than previously. More stickiness noticed on my face than when I use it on the hands and feet, but definitely nothing that is annoying, especially with the way it has been helping with my face. Also helps with the wrinkles. I just started with my second bottle and I will most definitely be continuing to use it . Pictures of hands are the same hand with the scratch on it. Had to bend my hand to be able to see the scratch.

Okay, i barely rate my putchases but this worths the time. Im a person with combination skin but mostly dry. I love this product and i use it as my moisturizer (usually no face cream unless a very dry day) and then my sunscreen. At night i use adapalene due acne problems, and retinal, so is a good thing to consider because those make your skin more dry!! Ill probably keep buying this unless i ran out of money u.u hahaha but it worth it. Ohh and barely use makeup (1st pic) but very good make up grip.
